formatName: HALO Photonics Doppler LiDAR File Format
formatDescription: HALO Photonics Doppler LiDAR File Format is a proprietary, text-based format that contains header information and time-series data for atmospheric measurements. It is designed for continuous remote sensing specifically to log atmospheric backscatter and line-of-sight wind velocity.
provenanceCompoundName: Digital Research Alliance of Canada - FRDR / Alliance de recherche numérique du Canada – DFDR
